text:
sam: Short postmortem follow-up: we had three repeating themes in the GPU incidents — quota lag, scheduler churn, slow node reprovision. Need owners, one-liner success metrics, and rollback gates.

anita: I'll take scheduler churn. Plan: instrument pod placement hotspots, adjust scoring weights, and add a light preemption cooldown. ETA config PR 2026-03-28, canary 2026-04-04. Metric: reduce scheduler churn events (pods rescheduled within 5m) by 60%. Rollback: revert if crashloop count increases >0.2%.

kevin: I'll own quota path + cloud fast-track. Tasks: audit reserved GPU leases, reclaim stale leases >14d, and open emergency quota procedure with cloud ops. ETA audit 2026-03-24, fast-path doc 2026-03-30. Metric: emergency quota turnaround <48h. Rollback: reapply reclaimed leases if we see >5% pod scheduling failures post-change.

sam: Great. Add headroom planning owner?

anita: I'll team up with kevin for headroom strategy. Proposal: baseline headroom = 10% for prod; add temporary bump when scheduler queue >80% for 15m. Runbook draft 2026-03-26. Metric: no capacity fallbacks during next 30 days after rollout. Rollback: disable auto-bump if wasted capacity >15% for 24h.

sam: Also add a small task to speed node reprovisioning. Reprovision was ~8-10m during incidents. Who can drive it?

kevin: I'll take node reprovision pipeline. Plan: slim images, parallelize init, and reduce external dependencies during boot. ETA 2026-04-08. Metric: median node ready time <3.5m in staging. Rollback: restore previous image pipeline if instability observed.

sam: Ops-bot, please create a tracker ticket with subtasks for: scheduler-churn (anita), quota-fastpath (kevin), headroom-runbook (anita+kevin), node-reprovision (kevin). Include ETAs and metrics above.

ops-bot: Created INC-2026-4412 with subtasks and calendar invite for a 30-min check-in on 2026-04-11 11:00 PT. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4412

kevin: Starting audit now, will post CSV in ticket by EOD.

anita: I'll upload a short test plan for the scheduler canary tonight.

sam: Any immediate blockers?

kevin: Need approval to reclaim two large reservations (res-9912, res-9930). @sam can you approve so I can proceed?

sam: Approved for those two. Add notes on which teams were notified.

anita: One ask: include rollback gates in the canary runbook. I'll draft them and tag infra for quick revert steps.

sam: Perfect. Keep updates in the ticket and ping this thread for anything urgent. Thanks. :thumbsup:
